NOTENOUGHDIFFICULTY-ENABLED.title: Enable this mod
NOTENOUGHDIFFICULTY-ENABLED.description: Master switch. When off, all gameplay changes stop applying (the custom Acts 4/5 still appear on the map, but no longer alter difficulty or map structure).
NOTENOUGHDIFFICULTY-DEBUG_LOGGING.title: Verbose debug logging
NOTENOUGHDIFFICULTY-DEBUG_LOGGING.descri: Off by default. When on, writes map structure, boss rolls and synthetic-campfire diagnostics to the game log - turn it on to troubleshoot and send the log to the author. Keep it off otherwise to avoid log spam.
NOTENOUGHDIFFICULTY-DIFFICULTY.title: Difficulty
NOTENOUGHDIFFICULTY-HP_SCALE_FACTOR.desc: HOW IT STACKS: final enemy HP = base HP x (1 + scaling%). scaling% = current floor x 0.1 x Y.\nDefault Y=1. Example: floor 10 gives 10 x 0.1 x 1 = +100% (double HP); with Y=2 it is +200% (triple).\nApplies only to acts where scaling is enabled (see the toggles below), and MULTIPLIES with ascension level and multiplayer HP bonuses.
NOTENOUGHDIFFICULTY-DMG_SCALE_FACTOR.des: HOW IT STACKS: final enemy damage = base damage x (1 + scaling%). scaling% = current floor x 0.05 x X.\nDefault X=1. Example: floor 10 gives 10 x 0.05 x 1 = +50%; with X=2 it is +100% (double).\nComputed INDEPENDENTLY from the HP formula (same floor, different coefficient: HP 0.1, damage 0.05).
NOTENOUGHDIFFICULTY-EXTRA_SCALING_PER_AC: Which acts receive extra scaling (controls X/Y above)
NOTENOUGHDIFFICULTY-ACT1_EXTRA_SCALING.d: Off by default: Act 1 stays vanilla. Turn on to apply the X/Y formula to Act 1.
NOTENOUGHDIFFICULTY-ACT2_EXTRA_SCALING.d: Off by default. Turn on to apply the X/Y formula to Act 2.
NOTENOUGHDIFFICULTY-ACT3_EXTRA_SCALING.d: Off by default. Turn on to apply the X/Y formula to Act 3.
NOTENOUGHDIFFICULTY-ACT4_EXTRA_SCALING.d: On by default. Act 4 is this mod's deep trial act.
NOTENOUGHDIFFICULTY-ACT5_EXTRA_SCALING.d: On by default. Act 5 is this mod's final trial act.
NOTENOUGHDIFFICULTY-INTER_BOSS_HEARTH.de: On by default. Inserts a campfire between the two bosses so you can rest/upgrade before the second fight. Implemented as a synthetic node at a virtual coordinate - the vanilla map structure is left untouched.
NOTENOUGHDIFFICULTY-INTER_BOSS_SHOP.desc: Off by default. Inserts a shop between the two bosses. When both are enabled the order is campfire -> shop.
NOTENOUGHDIFFICULTY-ACT1_DOUBLE_BOSS.des: Off by default. When on, Act 1 gets a second boss, with a rest site placed between the two bosses.
NOTENOUGHDIFFICULTY-ACT2_DOUBLE_BOSS.des: Off by default. Same rule as Act 1.
NOTENOUGHDIFFICULTY-ACT3_DOUBLE_BOSS.des: Automatically skipped on Ascension 10 (N10): Act 3's second boss is owned by N10 (vanilla intends it for Act 3, and this mod pins it back there). Without N10, turn this on to add a second boss to Act 3 manually.
NOTENOUGHDIFFICULTY-ACT4_DOUBLE_BOSS.des: Off by default. When on, Act 4 fights one more boss after its top boss.
NOTENOUGHDIFFICULTY-ACT5_DIFFICULTY.desc: 0 = Trial: Ancient Name -> a random Act 1 boss -> a random Act 2 boss -> the final boss (the one assigned to Act 3). 1 = Extreme: takes every undefeated boss from Acts 1-3 cycling 1-2-3, with a rest site between fights (rest sites = fights - 1), and an Act 3 boss as the grand finale. Both tiers key off encounter IDs only (from map history; undefeated first), roll from the run seed, and never hardcode boss names. Up to 6 fights fit in this act; any excess is reported as dropped in the log.

NOTENOUGHDIFFICULTY-SPEED.title: Speed
NOTENOUGHDIFFICULTY-ENABLE_EXTRA_SPEED.d: Off by default. When on, the multiplier below speeds up the whole game (engine-level TimeScale: animations and timers), stacking on top of the game's built-in Fast Mode. Purely local presentation - it does not affect multiplayer sync, so each player can set their own speed.
NOTENOUGHDIFFICULTY-EXTRA_SPEED_MULTIPLI: Default 2.0, range 0.5-10.0. Higher is faster. Kept in sync with the extra row injected into the game's official settings screen (they mirror each other).
NOTENOUGHDIFFICULTY-ACT5_MAP.title: Act 5 map
NOTENOUGHDIFFICULTY-ACT5_LINEAR_MAP.desc: On by default. Act 5 uses a custom straight-line map: Ancient Name -> (disguised boss -> rest site) -> final boss. Disguised bosses are random undefeated bosses from Acts 1-3, each with its own icon (custom map-node class), fought as elite-tier monster rooms that do NOT end the act; only the final boss uses the vanilla finale. When there are many nodes they are spaced evenly inside the map and scaled down proportionally (they never leave the map bounds). Turn it off to use the vanilla map shape.
NOTENOUGHDIFFICULTY-COMPAT.title: Mod compatibility
NOTENOUGHDIFFICULTY-ACT4_HEART_AUTO_SHIF: Auto-shift when Act 4 is taken (Act 4 Heart etc.)

On by default. When Act 4 turns out to be occupied by another mod (for example Act 4 Heart), this mod's two acts shift to Acts 5 and 6: the elite gauntlet becomes Act 5 and the Legend/Myth act becomes Act 6, and both are kept at the end of the act list. Detection (no act type is hardcoded): (1) the game's ActsByIndex slot for act 4 contains an act that is not ours; (2) an act in the global list declares Index >= 3; (3) an act whose name/id contains 'heart' (fallback). The Act4_* / Act5_* switches always apply to THIS mod's own two acts and never drift with the shift, so turning this on does not invalidate your existing settings. Turn it off to never shift (both mods would then write into Act 4 - not recommended).
NOTENOUGHDIFFICULTY-ACT4_OVERRIDE_ENCOUN: Gauntlet act: force-override self-backed enemies (off by default)

Off by default. In the elite gauntlet act (Act 4, or the shifted act when Act 4 is taken), the combat background follows the enemy's own source act. For modded enemies that ship a fixed custom background (for example the hand-drawn arena in ActsFromThePast), this mod respects that background and does not override it - it is the other mod's deliberate art. Turn this on to force a background rebuilt from the source act, at the cost of losing that mod's art.
